body:
## Why
The MVP heartbeat edits the run comment (a content write, 10-min floor). The design calls for a compare-and-swap on the lock ref so heartbeats are free and a reclaim is detected atomically.

## What
- `hkb heartbeat <n>`: advance `refs/kb/locks/<n>/<k>` to a fresh object using `git push origin <new>:refs/kb/locks/<n>/<k> --force-with-lease=refs/kb/locks/<n>/<k>:<expected>` from the worktree (the expected sha is recorded in the attempt). Rejected lease ⇒ exit 3 `LOCK_LOST`.
- Fresh object: an empty commit on top of the current lock sha (`git commit-tree` of the same tree) — created locally, not via REST.
- Keep the run-comment heartbeat as a fallback when `git` push is unavailable (cloud tiers), selected by profile.
- Dispatcher reclaim reads the ref sha's commit timestamp instead of `heartbeat_at` for Tier A attempts.
- Update `skills/kanban/SKILL.md` step 3 and `references/protocol.md`.

## Done when
Fake-gh tests cover lease rejection ⇒ LOCK_LOST; a manual round trip on this repo works.
title: Ref-CAS heartbeat: LOCK_LOST via git push --force-with-lease on the lock ref
